Built a playable 3D zombie shooter in the project and it’s running locally.

- App URL: http://127.0.0.1:3002
- Stack: Vite + Three.js
- Core features:
  - 3D arena with ambient lighting and fog
  - Wave-based zombie spawning
  - Player movement and aiming
  - Shooting, health, weapon ammo, kill counter, wave HUD
  - Responsive browser game layout

Controls:
- WASD / Arrow keys: move
- Mouse: aim
- Click / Space: shoot
- R: quick reload

Files added:
- package.json
- index.html
- src/main.js
